تلتوون (form VIII)
# تَلْتَوُونَ (taltawūna) /tal.ta.wuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِلْتَوَى (iltawā)
# تُلْتَوَوْنَ (tultawawna) /tul.ta.waw.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِلْتَوَى (iltawā)
